tools.name: audit_funders
tools.description:
Every address that sent this wallet the asset, with amounts, transfer counts and block ranges.

One address at a time; run audit.cluster on a set. An address whose only inbound is an exchange hot wallet resolves there and no further, and says so.

tools.description: Settle what you have used. Every paid call adds 250ms to your balance and switches the meter on. `tick` is that purchase with no work attached. How many blocks you can buy is how much collateral is behind the channel.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: notes_sign · Private data: audit_funders, notes_sign, notes_post, notes_read, sample, how_to_pay · Public sink: notes_sign, notes_post · Destructive: audit_funders, notes_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: notes_sign · Private data: audit_funders, notes_sign, notes_post, notes_read, sample, how_to_pay · Public sink: notes_sign, notes_post · Destructive: audit_funders, notes_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
